SELECT
DATE_TRUNC('month', sample_time)::date AS month,
  SUM(increase) FILTER (WHERE figure = 'HC') AS "Heure Creuse",
  SUM(increase) FILTER (WHERE figure = 'HP') AS "Heure Pleine",
  SUM(increase) FILTER (WHERE counter = 'Production') AS "Production",
  SUM(increase) FILTER (WHERE counter = 'AutoConso') AS "AutoConso"
FROM electricity_counter_archive
WHERE sample_time >= '2015-01-01'
AND "increase" < 500000
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

SELECT
  date_trunc('year', sample_time) AS "time",
  to_char(sample_time, 'TMMonth') AS metric,
  SUM(increase)
FROM
  electricity_counter_archive
WHERE
  figure = 'HP'
  AND sample_time >= '2015-01-01'
GROUP BY
  1, 2
ORDER BY
  1, 2;

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('Year', sample_time)::date AS Year,
SUM(increase) AS "Heure Creuse"
FROM electricity_counter_archive
WHERE 
  figure='HC' 
  AND sample_time >= '2015-01-01'
  AND sample_time <= $__timeTo() 
GROUP BY Year;

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('Year', sample_time)::date AS Year,
SUM(increase) AS "Heures Plaines"
FROM electricity_counter_archive
WHERE 
  figure='HP'
  AND sample_time >= '2015-01-01'
  AND sample_time <= $__timeTo() 
GROUP BY Year;

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('Year', sample_time)::date AS Year,
SUM(increase) AS "Production"
FROM electricity_counter_archive
WHERE 
  figure='BASE'
  AND sample_time >= '2015-01-01'
  AND sample_time <= $__timeTo()
  AND increase < 500000
GROUP BY Year;

SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('Day', sample_time)::date AS Day,
  TO_CHAR(sample_time, 'MM-DD Dy') AS label,
  SUM(increase) FILTER (WHERE counter = 'AutoConso') AS "AutoConso",
  SUM(increase) FILTER (WHERE figure = 'HC') AS "Heure Creuse",
  SUM(increase) FILTER (WHERE figure = 'HP') AS "Heure Pleine",
  SUM(increase) FILTER (WHERE counter = 'Production') AS "Production"
FROM electricity_counter_archive
WHERE sample_time >= $__timeFrom()
AND sample_time <= $__timeTo()
AND "increase" < 500000
GROUP BY Day, label
ORDER BY Day;
